purpose: Teach: 一人ひとり/要注意/停電/クッション/ワンピース/落ち込む/ねぎ/玉ねぎ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お友達、絶対、一人ひとり、絶対、大事にね
lines.en: Sho — I need you to really, truly treasure each of your friends. Promise me that.
lines.style: Warm but firm. Leans in slightly. The opening 「本気で、絶対」carries weight — this matters. Steady eye contact. A mother's voice asking for something that actually costs.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、横断歩道、絶対、要注意、絶対、だよね
lines.en: Mom — you really, truly have to be careful crossing the street, okay? You know that.
lines.style: Quiet and serious. Small voice trying to match hers. The repetition is sincere, not parroting — he's checking that he understands what matters to her. Slight nod at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お風呂中、絶対、停電、絶対、心配だわ
lines.en: Sho — I worry about you in the bath if the power goes out. That really concerns me.
lines.style: Softer here. Not lecturing — genuinely troubled by something she hadn't mentioned before. The worry is real. A pause before finishing, like she's admitting something vulnerable.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ソファの、本気で、絶対、クッション、絶対、ふかふかだよ
lines.en: Mom — the sofa cushions are really, truly so soft, aren't they?
lines.style: Small, bright voice. Not correcting — he's noticing something true and wants her to notice it with him. Genuine delight, the way a six-year-old sounds when he finds something that makes sense.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お姉ちゃんの、絶対、ワンピース、絶対、お洒落ね
lines.en: Sho — your older sister's dress really is very stylish. She has good taste.
lines.style: Warm approval in her voice. A gentle observation, almost to herself. Not overdone — just noticing something true about someone she cares about. Settled and sure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、テストで、本気で、絶対、落ち込む、絶対、気持ち、絶対、あるよ
lines.en: Mom — when I do badly on a test, I really do feel down about it sometimes.
lines.style: Quieter, more honest than his earlier lines. The shift is real — he's telling her something true about himself, not echoing her. A small vulnerability. The voice steadies at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お味噌汁の、本気で、絶対、ねぎ、絶対、刻んでくれる?本気で
lines.en: Sho — could you chop up the green onion for the miso soup? I'd really appreciate it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and practical. The weight lifts — she's asking for help with something real and immediate. Not urgent, just a gentle request. The voice settles into everyday kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、玉ねぎ、絶対、苦手だよ
lines.en: Mom — I really don't like onions, you know.
lines.style: Small, honest admission. Not dramatic — just a simple preference stated plainly. The way a child tells the truth without worrying how it lands. Natural and unguarded.
